description: Run a saved report now: its date range is worked out on the shop's calendar (or around as_of), and the report operation runs with the caller's own permissions. Returns the exact input used and the operation's result.

as_of.description: Work the range out as if today were this day (shop's time zone).

name: reports_run

input.description: The input the report operation ran with.

params.description: Settings passed to the operation (shop_id and range dates are filled in at run time).

result.description: The report operation's own output; see that operation for its shape.
